name: Monotonic Minimum Teaching-Set Size of the Minimum Teaching-Set Separation Class
proof: The four-concept subfamily 000, 100, 010, 110 is a two-cube, in which every concept needs both x1 and x2, giving the lower bound two. Every subfamily containing 001 has a one-point teacher for 001 at x3; every remaining subfamily is contained in that two-cube and has a teacher of size at most two. Hence the maximum over subfamilies is exactly two.
